source.title: Blockchain Solutions for Multi-Agent Robotic Systems: Related Work and Open Questions

accepted.question_text: How can researchers develop a conceptual model of information support for a group of robots while the group is performing a task, in the setting of blockchain-based multi-agent robotic systems where an immutable distributed ledger stores relevant information, gives agents access to that information, and is intended to improve trusted interaction among agents?
accepted.context_brief: Information support model for robot groups

evidence.quote: Development of a conceptual model of information support for a group of robots during the task performance;

accepted.question_text: How can researchers develop a typical ontological model of a robotic system for blockchain-based multi-agent robotic systems, where the broader goal is intelligent support for agent interactions that raises the level of trust in the system?

evidence.quote: Development of a typical ontological model of a robotic system;

accepted.question_text: How can researchers develop a consensus protocol that verifies group interaction before a robotic group launches a task, using information from a distributed ledger in a blockchain-based multi-agent robotic system?

evidence.quote: Development of a consensus protocol for a group interaction verification before launching a task based on the information from a distributed ledger;

accepted.question_text: How can researchers develop a validation method for task performance by a robotic system in a blockchain-based multi-agent setting, where smart contracts and distributed-ledger information are used to support trusted agent interaction and liability-execution verification?

evidence.quote: Development of a validation method for task performance by the robotic system;

accepted.question_text: How can researchers develop a multi-agent system architecture for blockchain-based robotic systems, especially for groups of mobile robots whose interactions are supported by an immutable distributed ledger and smart contracts?

How can researchers prototype a proof-of-concept framework for an intelligent group of robots that performs a collaborative task, in the context of blockchain-based multi-agent robotic systems designed to provide trusted information support and improve interactions among agents?

evidence.quote: Prototyping of a framework for an intelligent group of robots performing a collaborative task (as a proof-of-concept).
